name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow — Intelligent Campus Management, Navigation and Student Services Platform

scripts.setup: composer install --working-dir=backend && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install && php backend/artisan migrate --seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:php && npm run check:api && npm run typecheck
